_comment: Settings layer that goes with the gateway-guard hooks. Put it in managed settings for customers, or in .claude/settings.json for a project. Replace gateway.example.com with your gateway host and the plugin source with yours.
_managed_only: In managed settings, also set allowManagedHooksOnly: true and force-enable this plugin under enabledPlugins, so users can't switch the hooks off and only managed or force-enabled hooks run.
